verdict.rationale: Base44 offers a CLI and SDK for creating projects, managing data entities (CRUD), syncing code, and deploying resources (base44-docs-4,5,17,19,23,24,28,31), plus GitHub sync and 'bring your own agent' sandbox access (base44-docs-2,3,18). However, core UI-only capabilities—AI-driven app generation from prompts, visual design/theme editing, whiteboard collaboration, template publishing, and login-page customization—have no documented API equivalent, and a probe found no OpenAPI spec exposed (base44-probe-2), suggesting the API surface is narrower than the full UI feature set. Missing for 10: API/SDK access to AI app-generation and design workflows, template publishing via API, and a discoverable API spec confirming full UI parity.
